reddish brown, The C horizons have color hue of 7.5YR through 10R. Color range is weak red, reddish brown, light reddish brown, and light brown. The soil may be noncalcareous in all parts. Thin lime crusts in the upper bedrock occur in some pedons.
Wibaux soils occur with Spearman, Thedalund and Cushman soils. They are not so deep and contain more coarse fragments than these soils. They lack the B2 horizon of the Spearman soils.
